articles.title: Indian Men's Hockey Team Finishes New Zealand Tour Unbeaten
articles.summary: The Indian men's hockey team completed their tour of New Zealand unbeaten by drawing the final match two-all in Auckland. India won the three-match series one-nil to celebrate a century of sporting ties between the two nations. Captain Sanjay led the scoring with three goals across the series, which marked a historic milestone dating back to nineteen twenty-six.

articles.title: Sourav Ganguly Questions India Spin Selection After Wellington Test Draw
articles.summary: Former India captain Sourav Ganguly questioned team selection after the opening Test against New Zealand ended in a draw in Wellington. India will now prepare for the second Test in Christchurch starting November 27.
